subject: Double charge on card
body: We were charged twice for the monthly subscription.
resolution: Confirmed duplicate charge caused by a retry during a payment-gateway timeout. Refunded the second charge (5-7 business days to appear) and sent the refund receipt.

subject: Invoice needs VAT ID
body: Our invoice is missing our VAT number.
resolution: Added the VAT ID under Settings > Billing > Tax details, regenerated the invoice and emailed the PDF. Future invoices include it automatically.

subject: Price increased without notice
body: Our plan price went up this month.
resolution: Explained the legacy-plan migration announced by email 60 days earlier, shared the notice, and applied a one-month courtesy credit for the difference.

subject: Bought too many seats
body: We purchased seats we don't need.
resolution: Removed the unused seats; the unused portion was credited to the account balance (prorated) rather than refunded to card, per billing policy.

subject: Annual plan discount timing
body: When does the annual discount apply?
resolution: Switching to annual takes effect immediately: the unused monthly time is prorated and the 20% annual discount applies to the new invoice.

subject: Pay by bank transfer
body: Can we pay by bank transfer instead of card?
resolution: Bank transfer (ACH/SEPA) and invoicing are available on annual Business plans; card and PayPal on all plans. Enabled invoicing for the customer.

subject: Threatened chargeback over duplicate charge
body: Customer threatened a chargeback after a double charge.
resolution: Manager approved immediate refund of the duplicate charge, apologised for the slow response, and added a goodwill credit. Customer withdrew the dispute.

subject: Password reset email not received
body: Reset emails never arrive.
resolution: Customer's mail server was rejecting our sender. Asked them to allowlist no-reply@ mail domain, then triggered a manual reset link valid for 30 minutes.

subject: Transfer account ownership
body: Owner left the company, need to change owner.
resolution: Verified the request from an existing admin, transferred ownership to the new email, and reminded them to remove the old user from Settings > Team.

subject: Add read-only teammate
body: How to give someone view-only access?
resolution: Settings > Team > Invite, choose the 'Viewer' role. Viewers can open dashboards and reports but can't edit or export.

subject: Delete all account data
body: Please remove all our data when we cancel.
resolution: Confirmed with the account owner in writing, scheduled deletion for the cancellation date, and sent the deletion certificate once complete (within 30 days).

subject: Suspicious API keys and logins
body: API keys we did not create appeared on our account.
resolution: Revoked all API keys, forced logout of all sessions, required password reset and enabled 2FA enforcement. Security team reviewed audit logs and shared findings within 24h.

subject: Request for DPA and sub-processors
body: Legal needs our data processing agreement.
resolution: Shared the signed DPA template and the sub-processor list from the trust center; countersigned the customer's DPA within 3 business days.

subject: Dashboard returning 500 errors
body: All dashboards show server error 500.
resolution: Linked to an ongoing incident on the status page (database failover). Resolved in 47 minutes; customer received the incident report.

subject: CSV import date error on large file
body: Import fails with invalid date format on big files.
resolution: Large files were split into chunks and the second chunk lost the header, so dates were parsed as text. Fixed in release 4.12; workaround was to import in files under 1,000 rows.

subject: Webhooks arriving late
body: Webhook events delayed by many minutes.
resolution: Webhook queue backlog after a deploy; engineering scaled the workers and delays returned to under 5 seconds. Failed deliveries were replayed automatically.

subject: Scheduled report PDFs are blank
body: Scheduled emails contain empty PDFs.
resolution: PDF renderer regression in the last release; engineering rolled back the renderer and re-sent the affected reports. Customer was told which reports were re-sent.

subject: Search fails with special characters
body: Searching for names with an apostrophe returns nothing.
resolution: Query parser did not escape apostrophes; fixed in release 4.9. Workaround until then was to search for the part of the name after the apostrophe.

subject: Mobile app crash after update
body: Android app closes on launch after update.
resolution: Crash in the new push-notification SDK on some Android versions. Hotfix 3.8.1 shipped same day; customers asked to update from the Play Store.

subject: Timestamps in UTC
body: Reports show the wrong timezone.
resolution: Report timestamps used the server timezone. Fixed by setting Settings > Workspace > Timezone; the 'Last updated' label now follows the workspace timezone since 4.10.

subject: Week starts on Sunday despite setting
body: Calendar ignores Monday week start preference.
resolution: Known bug: the date picker read the browser locale instead of the user preference. Fixed in 4.11; clearing the browser cache applies it.

subject: Okta SSO support
body: Do you support SAML SSO with Okta?
resolution: SAML SSO (Okta, Azure AD, Google) is available on the Business plan and above. Shared the setup guide and offered a call with the solutions team.

subject: Dark mode request
body: Please add a dark theme.
resolution: Logged the vote on the public roadmap item 'Dark mode' (planned for Q1). Customer subscribed to updates.

subject: Schedule exports to cloud storage
body: Can exports be scheduled to Google Drive?
resolution: Not native yet; logged on the roadmap. Shared a workaround: use the scheduled export email plus the Zapier integration to drop files into Google Drive.

subject: Bulk update via API
body: Need an endpoint to update many records at once.
resolution: The v2 API has a batch endpoint (up to 500 records per call); shared docs. Bulk tag editing specifically is on the roadmap and the customer joined the beta list.

subject: Agency partner program
body: Do you work with agencies or resellers?
resolution: Shared the partner program page (20% recurring commission, partner dashboard) and connected them with the partnerships team.
